intro.title: Owning property in Greece should be an opportunity, not an operational burden.
intro.body1: Sivan Management provides comprehensive management, rental operations and property care for residential, commercial and hospitality assets across Crete, with a particular focus on Chania, Rethymno and Heraklion.
intro.body2: From preparing your property for the market and finding the right tenants or guests to running daily operations, maintenance and reporting, we bring every essential service together under one coordinated approach.
intro.closing: One property. One trusted partner. Complete peace of mind.

insights.title: Knowledge for property owners in Greece.

items.q: What exactly does your management include?
items.a: It depends on the asset and the agreement. A full-service mandate typically covers marketing, pricing, guest or tenant communication, check-in and check-out, housekeeping, maintenance coordination, supplier management, expense control and regular owner reporting. We put the scope in writing before we start.

We work with a percentage of rental income, a fixed monthly fee, fees for individual services, or a combination. The right model depends on the property type, its size and how much we manage. You receive a written proposal after the assessment, and there are no hidden charges.
Through our online owner portal and by email. You can see bookings, income, expenses and maintenance at any time, and you receive a periodic statement with the details.

items.q: How do you handle repairs and emergencies?
items.a: Small, urgent issues are handled immediately within an agreed spending limit. Larger works are quoted and sent to you for approval first. Every intervention is logged with photos and invoices.

items.q: Can you manage my property if I live abroad?
items.a: Yes. Many of our owners live outside Greece. We act as your local representative, communicate in several languages and keep you informed online.
Request a property assessment. We will arrange a call, visit the property, and send you a tailored management proposal.

cta.title: Let's talk about your property.
cta.body: Tell us about your property, where it is and what you would like to achieve. We will review your requirements and propose a management approach tailored to your asset.
